apps.name: Aidoku
apps.description: Aidoku is a free and open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS with no ads and no tracking. Content comes from community-maintained source lists that you add yourself, so nothing is bundled with the app. It downloads chapters for offline reading, syncs library, history and settings through iCloud, supports external trackers, and offers paged, vertical and continuous reading modes with customisable layouts.
apps.changelog:

- OCR dictionary support (iOS 18+): import Yomitan-compatible dictionaries in the app and look up words while reading.
- Suwayomi built-in source: read and track from a Suwayomi instance, just like Komga and Kavita.
- Auto scroll for webtoon reader: enable and press the play button to scroll without touching your device.
- Fixed CloudFlare handling: CloudFlare issues that caused external sources to break should be resolved.
- Overall performance improvements: the library loads much faster (@Amqx), and the webtoon reader was improved.
- Source stability fixes and disable option: the issue where sources were causing the app to crash should not happen again, and now you can even disable a source that is broken until it receives an update.
- Many more things: see [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.description: iTorrent is a fully featured open-source torrent client for iOS. It keeps downloading in the background, integrates with the Files app, supports magnet links, sequential download and per-file selection, and ships a built-in VLC-based player with Picture in Picture, audio and subtitle tracks and playback speed control.
apps.shortDescription: Torrent client with a built-in player
apps.changelog:
iTorrent 2.2.0 | iTorrent

## What's new:
* Meet the new built-in VLC player. Play compatible video and audio files directly in iTorrent, even while they are still downloading.
* Enjoy Picture in Picture, playback speeds from 0.5x to 2x, audio and subtitle track selection, precise seeking, and system media controls.
* Take playback to a bigger screen with AirPlay or a compatible player discovered on your local network.
* Choose how pieces are downloaded with Sequential and First & Last priority modes, making it easier to start watching sooner.
* Select and share multiple completed files or entire folders in one go.

## Improvements:
* Refreshed the interface for iOS 26, with Liquid Glass styling, cleaner dialogs, and more polished navigation.
* Made torrent details smoother and easier to use, with clearer download-priority controls and private-torrent information.
* Improved media previewing so iTorrent can offer the best available player for each file.
* Updated the torrent and media engines for better compatibility, stability, and recovery from unexpected errors.
* Expanded and refined translations across all supported languages.

## Fixes:
* Fixed cases where magnet links could be saved incorrectly.
* Fixed a startup race condition that could interfere with launching the app or completing initial setup.
* Fixed toolbars and navigation behaving incorrectly in iPad split-screen mode.
* Fixed RSS downloads returning to the wrong screen.
* Fixed torrent details sometimes getting stuck in a continuous update loop.
* Fixed several playback, AirPlay, and local-device connection issues.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XITRIX/iTorrent/compare/v2.1.1-1...v2.2.0-1

apps.name: LiveContainer
apps.description: LiveContainer runs other iOS apps inside itself instead of installing them, so a single app slot on your certificate can host many sideloaded apps and you stop burning through the 3-app limit. When JIT is available it bypasses codesigning entirely; otherwise guest apps are signed with the same certificate as LiveContainer. It supports multiple data containers per app, tweak injection, adding guest apps to the Home Screen, and multitasking windows on iPadOS 16 and later.
apps.shortDescription: Run iOS apps without actually installing them
apps.changelog:
LiveContainer 3.8.0 | LiveContainer

# LiveContainer 3.8.0

> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation.
> To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore (`LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa`), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details.

# New Features

## Storage Management

- Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
- Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
- Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches.

## Multiple LiveContainers
- Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367)

## Share to Apps in LiveContainer
Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (#1357)

## Multitasking

- Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (#1208)
- Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (#1228, #1250)
- Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling.
- URL schemes and `open-url` payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows.

## JIT
- Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler.

## TweakLoader
You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN

# Improvements
- Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (#1194)
- IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded.
- Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support.
- Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress.
- Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions.
- Add a "Clear Notification" button (#1388)
- Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (#1417)

# Bug Fixes

- Fixed `livecontainer://open-url` dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (#1339)
- Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (#1209)
- Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an `en.lproj` path. (#1239)
- Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (#1365, #1368)
- Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (#1347)
- Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (#1386)
- Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (#1430)
- Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (#1300, #1310, #1329)
- Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (#1402, #844, #870)
- Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (#1394, #1417, #1416)
- Fix background downloads in multitask apps (choosing "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" is required). (#1415)

# Localization

- Updated translations. Added Spanish translation by @Deci8BelioS

# Credits

Thanks to everyone who contributed code, fixes, testing, and reports for this release, including @boa-z, @ruri1208, @Project516, @yazdipour, @stossy11, and @SAOMDVN.

Great thanks to everyone who helped translate LiveContainer.

apps.description: Provenance is a multi-emulator front-end covering Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony systems from a single library. apps.changelog:
Provenance 3.3.0 | Provenance-3.3.0-iOS

## What's New in 3.3.0

This is a big one. Four months of work since 3.2.1 covering iCloud sync, a completely revamped tvOS interface, video filters, and a ton of core and stability fixes.

### ☁️ iCloud / CloudKit Sync
- ROMs, save states, BIOS files, and artwork now sync across devices via iCloud
- Real-time download progress indicators when loading cloud save states
- Auto BIOS sync on game load when available in iCloud
- ROM metadata syncs alongside files
- Artwork syncs after library updates
- CloudKit records management tab in Settings
- iCloud upsell UI for new users with empty libraries
- Sync queue pauses during emulation and resumes after

### 📺 New tvOS UI (Default)
- Completely redesigned tvOS interface now enabled by default
- RetroWave-themed side menu with smooth animations
- Save states browser accessible from the main UI with artwork and core name
- "View All" saves section with per-system filtering
- TopShelf v2: recent games and save states with artwork and timestamps
- Cheats UI in the pause menu
- Game "More Info" panel
- Log viewer tab
- Import status view in side menu
- Search with persistent history
- Dozens of focus, navigation, and theming fixes throughout

### 🎨 Video Filters & Shaders
- Unified filter pipeline works across native and RetroArch cores
- GB and VHS filters improved
- Filters accessible from the pause menu
- RetroArch GLES 3D cores now supported (Vecx/GLiden, etc.)
- Dolphin shader/filter support
- PPSSPP filter support

### 🎮 Core & Controller Fixes
- **RetroArch**: Fixed player index mapping for MFi, PS4, and Xbox controllers; PS4 start/select fixed; 32x controls added; GameCube controller responder added
- **Mupen64Plus**: Fixed PS4 start button; fixed tvOS scaling and placement; better save error messages
- **Dolphin**: Fixed Vulkan landscape rendering
- **GenPluGX**: Added CHD support; added wide-screen GameGear core
- **PicoDrive**: Fixed crash on unload; fixed 32x controller mapping
- **FCEUmm**: Fixed start/select button mapping
- **Mednafen**: Fixed DualShock/DualSense pause/play button mapping
- **GameBatte / TGDB Dual**: Fixed PSX/Xbox pause/select button mapping

### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Stability
- Fixed multiple app hangs from main-thread Realm access (moved to background)
- Fixed crash in pause menu when closing core
- Fixed potential crash if audio ring buffer init fails
- Fixed crash in share/import extension
- Fixed aspect ratio issues in Stella and some other cores
- Fixed FPS label appearing in screenshots
- Fixed artwork not refreshing in game library after sync
- Fixed game importer re-queuing already-imported items
- Fixed Realm contentless core crash
- Fixed "Continue" carousel metadata mismatch
- Skin selector refreshes orientation previews on rotation change
- ManicSkin/DeltaSkin files can now be opened directly from Safari
- iPad import status modal clipped layout fixed
- DSP audio engine fixes

### ⚡ Performance
- Artwork loading significantly faster
- Game library UI rendering optimizations (removed unnecessary Observable wrappers)
- Async tab bar icon loading
- CloudKit sync deduplication and repeat-lookup fixes
- Game importer skips MD5 hashing for large non-BIOS files

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Provenance-Emu/Provenance/compare/3.2.1...3.3.0

apps.name: UTM
apps.description:
Run real operating systems on your iPhone or iPad. UTM is an open-source (Apache-2.0) virtualization and emulation platform built on QEMU, capable of running Windows, Linux, classic Mac OS and dozens of other systems alongside your apps.

Highlights:
- QEMU v10.0.2 backend with support for dozens of CPU architectures (x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V, PowerPC and more)
- Improved machine wizard with well-tested configurations such as Windows, Ubuntu, RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x and Windows 95/98
- Custom keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Del) sent directly to the VM from the Keyboard menu
- App Intents automation with the Shortcuts app
- Liquid Glass design on iOS 26
- Import and export .utm virtual machine bundles via the Files app
- No jailbreak required; highest performance with JIT workarounds on supported iOS versions
apps.changelog:
UTM 4.7.5 | Universal IPA

## Highlights
* **QEMU v10.0.2**: The backend has been updated to the latest upstream QEMU which brings with it a variety of bug fixes and performance improvements.
* **Liquid Glass**: UTM adopts the Liquid Glass design on *OS 26.
* **App Intents**: New support for automation with Shortcuts.
* **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Define custom key combinations (such as Ctrl+Alt+Del) that can be sent to the VM from the new Keyboard menu.
* **Improved Wizard**: Simplify the creation of emulated machines by selecting from a list of well-supported configurations. The updated wizard can create more working configurations such as RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x, and Windows 95/98.

## Changes (v4.7.5)
* Fixed some rare conditions that could lead to a VM fail to start and spin infinitely
* Fixed some rare crashes that can happen after a VM stops
* Fixed parsing of file paths with commas in the name (thanks @nikolan123)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the GLES backend (#7546) (thanks @cnnn)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the Metal backend (#4958)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Fixed App Intents on macOS 26 (#7412) (thanks @peterneutron)
* (macOS) Fixed an error when file locking is disabled and a removable drive with no image selected is started (#7527)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed shared directory disconnecting when window is resized (#7488) (thanks @evan314159)
* Hotfix: (1/3/25) An earlier release of v4.7.5 has an issue that prevented VMs from starting. Make sure you are on build 118.

## Changes (v4.7.4)
* (macOS) Fixed a crash on VM start when a toolbar menu was reinitialized (note v4.7.4 was re-released to address this) (#7408)
* Home: Fixed layout issue with button titles
* (macOS) Fixed a crash when VM exits while USB is active
* (iOS) Support for StikDebug on iOS 26 (non-SE only)

## Changes (v4.7.3)
* Fixed a crash when starting a VM results in a block device error
* Stop button can now be used a second time to force kill a VM if it is unresponsive after stopping for the first time
* libusb: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes when using USB capture
* CocoaSpice: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes during VM start
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed broken commands due to name collision (#7360)
* (macOS) Fixed crash when exiting full screen (#7377)

## Changes (v4.7.2)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed a crash when starting any Apple Virtualization VM (#7355) (We are re-releasing v4.7.2 with build 112 due to this critical bug.)
* Home: Display network details and active IP addresses on the home details screen (thanks @gabefair)
* Home: Show a security warning message when importing a .utm with custom arguments (#6252)
* Config: Option to reset UEFI without pre-loading Secure Boot keys (useful for custom TPM configurations) (#7005)
* Config: Pre-loading Secure Boot keys will now install Microsoft UEFI 2023 certificates (#7257)
* Config: When PS/2 device is enabled, no longer create USB mouse and keyboard devices. This allows older Windows install to work out of the box.
* Config: Quotes in custom arguments are no longer stripped (unless the only quotes wrap the entire argument) (#6343)
* Config: Provide a fixed serial number for VirtIO block devices (#7332)
* QEMU: Fixed an issue which causes Windows 98 to BSoD (#7342)
* QEMU: Do not create a default floppy drive when -nodefaults is used. UTM configuration will set up a FDC device and this is the only way to set up bootindex for floppy.
* Wizard: Legacy Windows configurations will now use PS/2 controller by default
* Wizard: Update OS logos to be consistent with other icons
* Wizard: Windows + i440fx hardware will now instantiate default devices (sound, VGA, networking) that should work with Windows 95/98
* Wizard: Add additional supported hardware configurations for running older Windows
* Wizard: Support floppy boot for Windows configuration
* Scripting: New input automation suite for sending keyboard and mouse input (#6462)
* USB: Fixed a rare crash when initializing the USB devices list (#5811)
* SPICE: Fixed an issue where monitor configuration sent to spice-vdagent contains an invalid size (#5832)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS) Toolbar: Fix foreground issue on iOS 26 beta 5 and higher
* (macOS) Added ability to auto-connect USB devices on start (#3400)
* (macOS) Fixed connecting USB devices from secondary windows
* (macOS) New "Virtual Machine" menu which mirrors the actions accessible through the toolbar
* (macOS) Keyboard Shortcuts toolbar icon is no longer shown by default (it can be placed on the toolbar through View -> Customize Toolbar). It is also accessible through the "Virtual Machine" menu.
* (macOS) Fixed sending simultaneous mouse button presses (#7068)
* (macOS) utmctl: Add `version` command to detect current UTM version
* (macOS) Settings: New option to disable key swapping on ISO keyboards (#6976)
* (macOS) Settings: New option to randomize network MAC addresses on clone (#7035)

## Changes (v4.7.1)
* New Liquid Glass icon thanks to @forcequitOS
* Added App Intents for VM operations (#6245)
* Added UEFI boot support for RISC-V64 and LoongArch64. This allows Ubuntu for RISC-V64 to work out of the box. (#7183)
* QEMU PPC: Disable `bootindex` when `boot-device` is used in prom-env. This allows Yellow Dog Linux for PPC to work out of the box. (#6436)
* QEMU x86_64: Fixed floppy boot order configuration for other PC models (isapc, i440fx) (#7166)
* QEMU PPC/M68K: Includes classicvirtio drivers to support cursor input without capture and directory sharing (#6520)
* QEMU M68K: Fixed virtio drive config (#7008)
* Fixed a rare crash after stopping VM due to a race condition in libusb
* Home: improve screenshot contrast in Dark Mode (#6894)
* Config: Fixed a crash when trying to enter a large size value when creating a new drive (#7295)
* Config: Corrected the default host IP address in port forwarding config to "0.0.0.0" when it incorrectly displayed "127.0.0.1" (#7132)
* Keyboard Shortcuts: Create custom combinations of keyboard shortcuts from either Settings -> Input or via the Keyboard icon in the VM (press and hold on iOS/visionOS). This will allow you to easily send key commands such as Ctrl+Alt+Del or Stop+A to the VM. (#5698, #6310, #6757)
* Wizard: New option to import an existing drive image when setting up a Linux VM. This allows Ubuntu for RISC-V64 to work out of the box. (#7183)
* Wizard: New option to create a serial port only Linux VM. This allows Ubuntu for RISC-V64 to work out of the box. (#7183)
* Wizard: Removed VHDX import option because Microsoft now provides ARM64 ISO images. Note: You can still create manually import an VHDX after creating a new VM.
* Wizard: New template to create classic Mac OS VMs for M68K and PPC (#3504, #6890)
* Wizard: Most common and supported machines for emulation are now listed prominently with the full list of supported QEMU architectures/targets hidden behind an "Expert" mode. This is necessary because most of the QEMU targets are not properly supported by the wizard anyways and does not generate a bootable config. They usually require a lot more manual tinkering. The page order of the wizard is also tweaked so the hardware config comes before the boot config now.
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS SE) Fixed a crash when launching ArchLinux due to mis-handling of REV32
* (iOS SE) Fixed a crash when the first instruction executed is a goto
* (iOS SE) Removed ARM32, RISC-V32, and added M68K. There is little use for ARM32 and RISC-V32 as they cannot boot anything useful that cannot also be booted by the 64-bit variant (which is still included).
